description: This deposit includes the release-ready English master monograph, the bounded English Journal Core article, English source files, English release assets, and audit materials for Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0. The Zenodo 1.3 upload is curated by OC_CORE_1_3_ZENODO_EN_ONLY_MANIFEST.json and contains only the English release package. Russian and German translation work is preserved in the repository as deferred Core 1.3.1 draft material and is excluded from this upload.
notes: The Journal Core article is a bounded extraction from the English master monograph. Russian and German translations are deferred to a separate post-1.3 translation review and are not release-blocking for this English deposit.
title: Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0
